G1401.def: from «1210»; a slave (literal or figurative, involuntary or voluntary; frequently, therefore in a qualified sense of subjection or subserviency):--bond(-man), servant.

G1402.def: from «1401»; to enslave (literally or figuratively):--bring into (be under) bondage, × given, become (make) servant.

G1403.def: from «1209»; a reception, i.e. convivial entertainment:--feast.

G1404.et: probably from an alternate form of derkomai (to look)
G1404.def: probably from an alternate form of derkomai (to look); a fabulous kind of serpent (perhaps as supposed to fascinate):--dragon.

G1405.et: perhaps akin to the base of (1404) (through the idea of capturing)
G1405.def: perhaps akin to the base of «1404» (through the idea of capturing); to grasp, i.e. (figuratively) entrap:--take.

G1406.def: from «1405»; a drachma or (silver) coin (as handled):--piece (of silver).

G1407.def: from drepo (to pluck); a gathering hook (especially for harvesting):--sickle.

G1408.def: from the alternate of «5143»; a race, i.e. (figuratively) career:--course.

G1409.et: a diminutive of Drusus (a Roman name)
G1409.def: a feminine diminutive of Drusus (a Roman name); Drusilla, a member of the Herodian family:--Drusilla.

G1410.def: of uncertain affinity; to be able or possible:--be able, can (do, + -not), could, may, might, be possible, be of power.

G1411.def: from «1410»; force (literally or figuratively); specially, miraculous power (usually by implication, a miracle itself):--ability, abundance, meaning, might(-ily, -y, -y deed), (worker of) miracle(-s), power, strength, violence, mighty (wonderful) work.

G1413.def: from «1410»; a ruler or officer:--of great authority, mighty, potentate.

G1415.def: from «1410»; powerful or capable (literally or figuratively); neuter possible:--able, could, (that is) mighty (man), possible, power, strong.

G1416.et: prolonged forms of an obsolete primary duo {doo'-o} (to sink)

G1418.pos: 1. prefix conveying the idea of difficulty, opposition, injuriousness, similar to our "mis-" or "un-" prefixes
G1418.et: a primary inseparable particle of uncertain derivation
G1418.def: a primary inseparable particle of uncertain derivation; used only in composition as a prefix; hard, i.e. with difficulty:--+ hard, + grievous, etc.

G1419.def: from «1418» and a derivative of «941»; oppressive:--grievous to be borne.

G1420.et: from (1418) and a comparative of (1787) (meaning a bowel)
G1420.def: from «1418» and a comparative of «1787» (meaning a bowel); a "dysentery":--bloody flux.

G1421.et: from (1418) and a presumed derivative of (2059)
G1421.def: from «1418» and a presumed derivative of «2059»; difficult of explanation:--hard to be uttered.

G1422.def: from «1418» and kolon (food); properly, fastidious about eating (peevish), i.e. (genitive case) impracticable:--hard.

G1424.def: from «1416»; the sun-set, i.e. (by implication) the western region:--west.

G1425.def: from «1418» and a derivative of «3539»; difficult of perception:--hard to be understood.

G1426.def: from a compound of «1418» and «5345»; defamation:--evil report.

G1427.def: from «1417» and «1176»; two and ten, i.e. a dozen:--twelve.

G1429.def: from «1427» and «5443»; the commonwealth of Israel:--twelve tribes.

G1430.def: from demo (to build); properly, an edifice, i.e. (specially) a roof:--housetop.

G1432.def: accusative case of «1431» as adverb; gratuitously (literally or figuratively):--without a cause, freely, for naught, in vain.

G1433.def: middle voice from «1435»; to bestow gratuitously:--give.

G1435.def: a present; specially, a sacrifice:--gift, offering.

G1436.pos: 1. interjection expressive of indignation, or of wonder mixed with fear, ha! ah!
G1436.def: apparent imperative of «1439»; properly, let it be, i.e. (as interjection) aha!:--let alone.

G1437.def: from «1487» and «302»; a conditional particle; in case that, provided, etc.; often used in connection with other particles to denote indefiniteness or uncertainty:--before, but, except, (and) if, (if) so, (what-, whither-)soever, though, when (-soever), whether (or), to whom, (who-)so(-ever). See «3361».

G1438.et: from a reflexive pronoun otherwise obsolete and the genitive case (dative case or accusative case) of (846)
G1438.def: from a reflexive pronoun otherwise obsolete and the genitive case (dative case or accusative case) of «846»; him- (her-, it-, them-, also (in conjunction with the personal pronoun of the other persons) my-, thy-, our-, your-) self (selves), etc.:--alone, her (own, -self), (he) himself, his (own), itself, one (to) another, our (thine) own(-selves), + that she had, their (own, own selves), (of) them(-selves), they, thyself, you, your (own, own conceits, own selves, -selves).

G1439.def: of uncertain affinity; to let be, i.e. permit or leave alone:--commit, leave, let (alone), suffer. See also «1436».

G1440.et: from (1442) and a modified form of (1176)
G1440.def: from «1442» and a modified form of «1176»; seventy:--seventy, three score and ten.

G1441.def: multiple adverb from «1440»; seventy times:--seventy times.

G1443.def: of Hebrew origin («05677»); Eber, a patriarch:--Eber.

G1444.def: from «1443»; Hebraic or the Jewish language:--Hebrew.

G1445.def: from «1443»; a Hebræan (i.e. Hebrew) or Jew:--Hebrew.

G1446.def: from «1443»; the Hebraistic (Hebrew) or Jewish (Chaldee) language:--Hebrew.

G1447.def: adverb from «1446»; Hebraistically or in the Jewish (Chaldee) language:--in (the) Hebrew (tongue).

G1448.def: from «1451»; to make near, i.e. (reflexively) approach:--approach, be at hand, come (draw) near, be (come, draw) nigh.

G1450.def: from «1722» and guion (a limb); pledged (as if articulated by a member), i.e. a bondsman:--surety.

G1451.et: from a primary verb agcho (to squeeze or throttle; akin to the base of (43))
G1451.def: from a primary verb agcho (to squeeze or throttle; akin to the base of «43»); near (literally or figuratively, of place or time):--from , at hand, near, nigh (at hand, unto), ready.

G1452.def: neuter of the comparative of «1451»; nearer:--nearer.

G1453.et: probably akin to the base of (58) (through the idea of collecting one's faculties)
G1453.def: probably akin to the base of «58» (through the idea of collecting one's faculties); to waken (transitively or intransitively), i.e. rouse (literally, from sleep, from sitting or lying, from disease, from death; or figuratively, from obscurity, inactivity, ruins, nonexistence):--awake, lift (up), raise (again, up), rear up, (a-)rise (again, up), stand, take up.

G1455.def: from «1722» and a derivative of «2524»; subinduced, i.e. surreptitiously suborned as a lier-in-wait:--spy.

G1456.et: plural of a presumed compound from (1722) and (2537)
G1456.def: neuter plural of a presumed compound from «1722» and «2537»; innovatives, i.e. (specially) renewal (of religious services after the Antiochian interruption):--dedication.

G1457.def: from «1456»; to renew, i.e. inaugurate:--consecrate, dedicate.

G1458.def: from «1722» and «2564»; to call in (as a debt or demand), i.e. bring to account (charge, criminate, etc.):--accuse, call in question, implead, lay to the charge.

G1459.def: from «1722» and «2641»; to leave behind in some place, i.e. (in a good sense) let remain over, or (in a bad sense) to desert:--forsake, leave.

G1460.def: from «1722» and «2730»; to settle down in a place, i.e. reside:--dwell among.

G1461.def: from «1722» and a derivative of «2759»; to prick in, i.e. ingraft:--graff in(-to).

G1462.def: from «1458»; an accusation, i.e. offence alleged:--crime laid against, laid to charge.

G1463.et: middle voice from (1722) and komboo (to gird)
G1463.def: middle voice from «1722» and komboo (to gird); to engirdle oneself (for labor), i.e. figuratively (the apron as being a badge of servitude) to wear (in token of mutual deference):--be clothed with.

G1465.def: from «1722» and «2875»; to cut into, i.e. (figuratively) impede, detain:--hinder, be tedious unto.

G1467.def: middle voice from «1468»; to exercise self-restraint (in diet and chastity):--can(-not) contain, be temperate.

G1468.def: from «1722» and «2904»; strong in a thing (masterful), i.e. (figuratively and reflexively) self-controlled (in appetite, etc.):--temperate.

G1469.def: from «1722» and «2919»; to judge in, i.e. count among:--make of the number.

G1470.def: from «1722» and «2928»; to conceal in, i.e. incorporate with:--hid in.

G1471.def: from «1722» and the base of «2949»; swelling inside, i.e. pregnant:--great with child.

G1472.def: from «1722» and «5548»; to rub in (oil), i.e. besmear:--anoint.

G1473.et: a primary pronoun of the first person I (only expressed when emphatic)
G1473.def: a primary pronoun of the first person I (only expressed when emphatic):--I, me. For the other cases and the plural see «1691», «1698», «1700», «2248», «2249», «2254», «2257», etc.

G1474.def: from «1475»; to raze:--lay even with the ground.

G1475.def: from the base of «1476»; a basis (bottom), i.e. the soil:--ground.

G1476.et: from a derivative of hezomai (to sit)
G1476.def: from a derivative of hezomai (to sit); sedentary, i.e. (by implication) immovable:--settled, stedfast.

G1477.def: from a derivative of «1476»; a support, i.e. (figuratively) basis:--ground.

G1478.def: of Hebrew origin («02396»); Ezekias (i.e. Hezekeiah), an Israelite:--Ezekias.

G1479.def: from «2309» and «2356»; voluntary (arbitrary and unwarranted) piety, i.e. sanctimony:--will worship.

G1480.def: from «1485»; to accustom, i.e. (neuter passive participle) customary:--custom.

G1481.def: from «1484» and «746»; the governor (not king) of a district:--ethnarch.

G1483.def: adverb from «1482»; as a Gentile:--after the manner of Gentiles.

G1484.def: probably from «1486»; a race (as of the same habit), i.e. a tribe; specially, a foreign (non-Jewish) one (usually, by implication, pagan):--Gentile, heathen, nation, people.

G1485.def: from «1486»; a usage (prescribed by habit or law):--custom, manner, be wont.

G1486.def: a primary verb; to be used (by habit or conventionality); neuter perfect participle usage:--be custom (manner, wont).

G1487.def: a primary particle of conditionality; if, whether, that, etc.:--forasmuch as, if, that, (al-)though, whether. Often used in connection or composition with other particles, especially as in «1489», «1490», «1499», «1508», «1509», «1512», «1513», «1536», «1537». See also «1437».

G1488.def: second person singular present of «1510»; thou art:--art, be.

G1489.def: from «1487» and «1065»; if indeed, seeing that, unless, (with negative) otherwise:--if (so be that, yet).

G1490.def: from «1487», «1161», and «3361» (sometimes with «1065» added); but if not:--(or) else, if (not, otherwise), otherwise.

G1491.def: from «1492»; a view, i.e. form (literally or figuratively):--appearance, fashion, shape, sight.

G1492.def: a primary verb; used only in certain past tenses, the others being borrowed from the equivalent «3700» and «3708»; properly, to see (literally or figuratively); by implication, (in the perfect tense only) to know:--be aware, behold, × can (+ not tell), consider, (have) know(-ledge), look (on), perceive, see, be sure, tell, understand, wish, wot. Compare «3700».

G1493.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «1497»; an image-fane:--idol's temple.

G1494.et: neuter of a compound of (1497) and a presumed derivative of (2380)
G1494.def: neuter of a compound of «1497» and a presumed derivative of «2380»; an image-sacrifice, i.e. part of an idolatrous offering:--(meat, thing that is) offered (in sacrifice, sacrificed) to (unto) idols.

G1496.def: from «1497» and the base of «3000»; an image- (servant or) worshipper (literally or figuratively):--idolater.

G1497.def: from «1491»; an image (i.e. for worship); by implication, a heathen god, or (plural) the worship of such:--idol.

G1498.et: optative (i.e. English subjunctive) present of (1510) (including the other person)
G1498.def: optative (i.e. English subjunctive) present of «1510» (including the other person); might (could, would, or should) be:--mean, + perish, should be, was, were.

G1499.def: from «1487» and «2532»; if also (or even):--if (that), though.
